page.overview:
Who is The Gopher?

The Gopher was easily defeated in his match against The Boulder in the tournament and later helped Xin Fu kidnap Avatar Aang and Toph, holding them for ransom. Following Toph's release and Xin Fu's refusal to free Aang, she battled and defeated each of the Earth Rumble VI fighters, including The Gopher.
